checks.what: file is 2 experiments x 4 conditions x 48 participant numbers x 350 trials
participant-by-condition blocks the README calls never recorded are empty and are left out
recorded sessions: 201 participant-by-condition blocks of 350 trials
the authors' trial number equals the row position within each session
trials with no recorded data inside recorded sessions are all flagged excluded by the authors
checks.detail: 139 such trials kept as placeholder rows

checks.what: trial type follows position: 1-50 baseline, 51-250 adaptation, 251-350 retention
participants with data: 26 small-target (paper: 26 recorded), 28 large-target (paper: 29 recorded; the one excluded for data quality has no data in the deposit)
participants in the analysis: 24 per experiment (Methods, Participants)
participants excluded for missing sessions: 2 small-target, 4 large-target (Methods: opted out)
adapDir.csv gives +2 deg (discriminate-1st conditions) or -2 deg (discriminate-2nd conditions) in every recorded session
eye movement target 10 deg straight up from the fixation cross in every trial with data
candidates 2 deg left and right of the target in every adaptation trial (first at +2 on the recoded axis), second candidate 349-351 ms after saccade detection
amplitudes equal end minus start positions; latency and duration equal timestamp differences
retinal error equals landing x minus the task-relevant candidate's x, in every trial with a saccade
blink, no-primary-saccade and no-response adaptation trials are all flagged excluded
ranges: latency 1-1500 ms, duration > 0, peak velocity > 0, |horizontal amplitude| < 13 deg
every row the authors shared for a recorded session is kept, in order
pert_value matches the logged task-relevant candidate offset on every adaptation row with data
time_s increases within every session
small-target, discriminate-1st: mean baseline-corrected horizontal primary saccade amplitude, last adaptation block (deg)
